final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT f.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(f.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanfeatures AS f JOIN sites AS s ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE f.traitcount >= 489 GROUP BY f.zoneref, s.entrystat), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM grouped) SELECT g.zoneref, g.entrystat, g.avg_traitcount, g.record_count, 1.0 * g.record_count / t.total_count AS proportion FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY proportion DESC LIMIT 10
